tei:div.tei:p: (ta)༄༅// chos kyi rgyal po'i rgya gzhung la li ta badz+ra gyis mdzad pa bzhugs so// ༄༅// rgya gar skad du/ ya ma karma rā dza dharmā sā dha na nā ma/ bod skad du/ las kyi gshin rje chos kyi rgyal po'i sgrub thabs zhes bya ba/ 'jigs byed chen po la phyag 'tshal lo// 'chi ba yi dwags rgyal po ni/

/ming gi rnam grangs/ 'chi bdag bdud lhan cig skyes pa'i ces bya ba ste/ /gang gi bdud na 'gro ba kun gyi las kyi bdud/ /ji ltar gnas na/ lus dang grib ma'i tshul bzhin du/ /gang la yod na 'gro ba kun la snang ba ste// phung po nying mtshams sbyor kun gyi srog len par byed ba yis// 'jigs pa de yi gzugs mthong nas/ srog /ya gshin rje ma de yi dri ngan 'byung*// des na rang gi srog len pas gi bdud// ltag pa'i phyogs na rtsa gshin rje'i gdong pa lta bu ste gnas pa ste/ /mche ba gtsigs pa can la phyag 'tshal lo// de la gzugs brnyan la brten te bsgrub pa/ 'chi bdag skyes bu'i gzugs// khru gang yi dwags gos ro ram la bri// nag po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa// 'jigs su rung ba pa ral pa mche bzhi gtsigs// rgyan sbrul dang stag lpags la sogs med rus pa'i phreng ba can// g.yas pa ya ma'i dbyug pa can// sdigs mdzub zhags pa g.yon na bsnams// gdan ma he dag la gnas pa bri// de nas rnal 'byor chen po yi/ sgrub pa po/ /ya ma'i mdun du gnas la zhi gnas bya// yang na ya'am dbyug pa'am gri gug sa ti rnam sa bon phyag mtshan lha sku/ gsum las// hūm̐ yang na las nag po chen po ste// yi ge bcu gcig brjod byas la// ras la bris pa bzhin du bsgom// oṃ gzugs nag po gshin rje'i rgyal po/ kā la rū pa ya ma rā dza hūm̐ phaṭa/ de nas bsnyen pa bya bar gsungs// dur khrod nags tshal song byas la// bzlas 'jigs byed kyi brjod byas pa'i tshul dag gis// ha ha bzhad dang po rmi lam du cing yong bar rig /mngon du gyur nas ba liṃ sbyin// de la bsnyen pa dang gtor ma gnyis 'ong ba la thog mar 'di'o/ bsnyen pa'i snying po 'di'o// oṃ kā la rū

gzugs nag po 'jigs pa'i gnod sbyin pa bhi ma yak+ṣa hūm̐ ma khro bo chen po/ hā ro ṣa ṇa/ mi'i grub pa na ra bar bcu bzhi sid+dha ye/ sarba bhū 'byung po thams cad kyi mnga' bdag ta a dhi pa ta ye/ ya ma tha ma rā gshin rje'i rgyal po/ dzā ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ thog ma bco lnga dang mtha' ma dang yang dag ldan// bcu bzhi bar gyi phye ba bsnyen pa yin// rim pa bzhin du ma phye ba// nye ba'i bsnyen khyad par gyi/ pa yin par shes// grub rtags rmi lam du gsal ste mngon du gyur pa na/ nub mang du byung na gtar bzung ba'i/ /sha chen gtor ma chen po sbyin// oṃ kā la rū pa ya ma rā dza hūm̐/ i daṃ ba lin+ta gtor ma'i sngags gṛh+ṇa kha kha khā hi khā hi/ tshogs la bsnyen pa thon pa dang nye bsnyen bya bstod/ sogs pa sngon du sbyin// de ltar grub nas las bya ste// bhan+dha mtshan ngan rabs chad bzang por bstsal// dum bu gcig gam gnyis pa la// dpral ba'i ngos nas ltag par drang*// mi thod dag gam ro ras la// gnod sbyin bai bha swa ta'i gzugs// snag tsha bya rog khrag dang ni// dur khrod sol ba bong bu'i chus// mi rkang smyug gus legs par bris/ /nye bsnyen dus su/ spyi bo'i ngos kyi phyogs dag la// ras la 'khor lo bri bar bya// rim pa gsum bskor ldan pa la// rim pa gnyis pa dag la ni// rtsibs gnyis gnyis kyi tshad la bri// de la gsang sngags 'god pa ni// ma ma sha trūṃ a mu kaṃ /'khor lo lte ba'i dbus su bri// shar nas brtsams pas 'di lta ste/ 1 /tro sa ya tro sa ya/ 2 a kaḍ+ḍha ya a kaḍ+ḍata ya/ 3 sho ṣa ya sho ṣa ya/ 4 ha na ha na/ 5 da ha da ha/ 6 pa tsa pa tsa/ 7 ban+dha ban+dha/ tsur+ṇa tsur+ṇa/ 8 rim pa tha ma dag la ni// shar nas brtsams nas 'di ltar bri/ 1 /tsak+ṣa badz+ra na gho ra sa tra ya/ 2 k+ṣe ṭa pā la ya/ 3 tshin+dha tshin+dha/

4 bhin+dha bhin+dha/ 5 thāṃ kaṃ bha dzaṃ pā ti/ 6 ru dhi ra ar+gha pa/ 7 māṃ sa ya/ 8 badz+ra ye badz+ra ye/ s+t+waṃ bha ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ bar du dgra yi ming rus bri// rgya srub dag la gsang sngags bri// skud pa sngon po nag po yis// thod pa de ni bsdam par bya// ro shing me la bhan+dha bsro// de ltar zhag gsum byas nas ni// las kyi 'chi bdag khru gang pa// zhal oṃ mā ra ya zhes zer ba 'dug go gcig phyag gnyis mche ba gtsigs// grog mkhar bdun dang rnam snang dang*// dur khrod sol ba'i rgyud dag la// bong bu'i chu yis gzugs byas te// de yi snying gar thod pa gzhug /'khor lo la bris sngags bzlas te// mar tshes bcu bzhi dang brgyad la// dur khrod lha khang dag tu mnan// de ltar las ni rdzogs gyur na// gang la byas pa'i dngos po de// rang gi bdud kyi dbang du 'gyur// 'chi ba yi dwags rgyal po ni// ma dros mtsho yi 'bri 'khyil la// ri nag dgu yi pha mtha' ste// spos ngad ri bo'i bar dag na// chu dang zheng du cha mnyam mtsho// de 'og dpag tshad lnga brgya'i 'og /'chi bdag yi dwags rgyal po'i gnas// 'gro ba'i ltag pa'i phyogs na gnas// de yi yum ste tsā muṇ+ḍī// rabs chad pho mo'i thod pa la// ya gnyis dag gi bar du yang*// ro ras dag la gzugs bri ba// zhal dang phyag zhabs sngon bzhin bri// de la 'chi bdag tsā muṇ+ḍī// nag po mig gsum khro gnyer can// kha gdangs skra brdzes nu ma 'phyangs// gsus chen dud 'gro'i gos gyon ma// g.yas na tri shūl g.yon pa yang*// mi yi thod pa dag dang sbyar// mi yi rgyus pas bsdams pa yi// bar du 'khor lo gzhug par bya// de nas 'chi bdag 'khor lo ni// snga ma bzhin du bri bar bya// de la ya ma mo 'khor ni// ras la 'chi bdag tshul bzhin du// rtsibs brgyad gnyis dang ldan pa yi// dbus nas brtsams nas 'di bzhin bri// ma ma sarba sha trūṃ/

lte ba'i dbus su bri bar bya/ shar nas rim pa 'di bzhin bri// a ka mu ka s+ya/ dhu kha na dhu na/ ba ga n+dha ban+dha/ ma nga thā ma thā/ pra ca ma thā pra ma thā/ cha hūm̐ dz+wa ra dz+wa ra/ ja dz+wa re ne bh+ya/ nya dhi ro ge naṃ/ rim pa tha ma dag la ni// shar nas rim pa 'di lta ste// ka nyi ka na shi baṃ/ kha yaṃ raṃ raṃ tshu s+ya/ a ga bi ṣa ya/ dza nga ma bhaṃ hri da yaṃ/ tshi ca n+dha tshin+dha/ ma cha de pa shi baṃ/ mā ja ra ya mā ra ya/ nā nya sha ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ 'khor lo gnyis kyi bar du yang*// gang la bya ba'i ming rus gzhug /bla mas 'chi bdag bsam byas te// srog gi snying po gdon par bya// gos sngon gyon pa de bzhin du// yum mam las mkhan dpa' bo ni// yum gyi srog snying bcu pa 'don// oṃ hrīḥtsā muṇ+ḍī bam̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ yab yum 'khor lo gang yin pa// gang gi thod par gzhug par bya// shi ba'i skra yi skud pa'am// mi rgyus dag gis mkhas pas bsdam// mi yi rgyus pas gzungs thag byas// gtso dang yum gyi gzugs byas nas// maṇ+ḍal steng bzhag bzlas pa bya// 'khor lo steng 'og sngags bzlas pa// gtso dang yum gyi 'bum phrag bzlas// de nas bzlas pa rdzogs pa dang*// dur khrod dang ni lha khang ngam// lha klu drag po'i gnas su mnan// lha la sogs pa shi bar bstan// de yi sgrub pa'i gnas rnams kyang*// dben pa'i phyogs su byas nas ni// bla ma pha ma mchod pa'i gnas// de la gnod pa'i dgra bo rnams// gang byung yang ni bsgral bar bya// de tshe bsgral bar ma byas na// rang nyid 'chi bar bstan pa yin// gsang bya gzhan la bstan mi bya// las kyi gshin rje chos kyi rgyal po'i sgrub thabs/ slob dpon la li ta badz+ras mdzad pa rdzogs so// bal po thugs rje chen po dang*/ bod kyi ban+de lo tsā ba rwa rdo rje grags kyis bsgyur ba'o// ༈ /dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed la phyag 'tshal lo// bcom ldan 'das kyi bsnyen pa sngon du song nas/ dgra bo rang gi srog gi bdud lus dang grib ma'i tshul bzhin du/

'chi bdag gi bdud ltag pa'i phyogs nas gshin rje'i gdong lta bu'i rtsa la brten nas dgra bo bsad pa'i man ngag la gsum ste/ bsnyen pa/ sgrub pa/ las sbyor ro// dang po dur khrod kyi ras la 'chi bdag zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa mdog nag po ral pa dang bcas shing mche ba gtsigs pa/ gcer bu rus pa'i rgyan can phyag g.yas pas thod dbyug 'dzin pa/ g.yon pas zhags pa dang bcas pa'i sdigs mdzub mdzad pa/ ma he'i steng na gnas pa bri'o// de'i yum tsa muṇ+ḍī mdog nag mo spyan gsum pa khro gnyer can zhal gdangs shing skra brdzes pa/ nu ma 'phyang ba glang po che'i ko rlon gon pa/ lag pa g.yas na tri shū la/ g.yon na thod pa bsnams pa bri'o// de la rab tu gnas par bya ba ni/ rang nyid rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi mngon par rtogs pa gsal bar bsgoms la bzlas pa cung zad cig byas la/ bris sku swa bhā was stong par byas la/ de'i ngang las sa bon phyag mtshan las ji ltar bris pa bzhin bskyed/ sku gsung thugs byin gyis brlab/ 'di nas dpag tshad lnga brgya'i sa 'og nas 'chi bdag yab yum bkug la dgug gzhug bya'o// de nas rig lngas dbang bskur bas chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las rdo rje rtse lnga pas dbu brgyan par bsgoms la/ oṃ kā la rū pa ya ma rā dza hūm̐ phaṭa/ brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas nas me tog gtor ro// de nas gnas dben par mchod pa dang gtor ma bshams la/ rang nyid 'jigs byed du gsal ba'i thugs ka nas 'od 'phros pas/ gshin rje pho mos las byed par bsam shing*/ oṃ kā la rū pa bhi ma yak+ṣa hūm̐/ mahā ro ṣa ṇa/ ya ma rā dzā ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ zhes 'bum phrag gcig bzlas so// thun mtshams su mchod pa dang gtor ma 'bul/ bstod pa byas/ phrin las bcol/ bsnyen pa bya ba'o// gnyis pa sgrub pa ni/ dur khrod la sogs pa'i gnas su phyin nas mchod gtor gong bzhin bsham/ khyad par du gtor ma sha chen dang khrag gis brgyan/

dmigs pa ni dgra bo'i liṅga dang 'khor lo'i ming spel la rnam shes dgug gzhug byas la/ sngags rim pa bzhin du ma 'chol bar bzlas pa ni/ oṃ kā la rū pa bhi ma yak+ṣa hūm̐/ ma hā ro ṣa ṇa/ na ra sid+dha ye/ sarba bhū ta a dhi pa ta ye/ ya ma rā dzā ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ zhes pa dang*/ oṃ hrīḥtsa mun+ḍī bam̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ zhes rtags ma byung bar du bzlas so// rtags byung nas gtor ma byin gyis brlabs nas sngags 'dis 'bul lo// oṃ kā la rū pa ya ma rā dza hūm̐/ i daṃ ba liṃ ta gṛh+ṇa gṛh+ṇa kha kha khā hi khā hi/ zhes pa lan bdun bzlas pas phul la mchod bstod 'phrin las gzhol/ sgrub pa'o// las la sbyar ba ni/ thod pa mtshan ngan dum bu gcig pa'am gnyis pa la dpral ba'i ngos nas ltag par drangs la/ de nas dur khrod kyi ras la snag tsha bya rog gi khrag dang*/ dur khrod kyi sol ba dang*/ bong bu'i chu bsres la mi rkang gi smyug gus 'khor lo dpe'u chung bzhin bris la/ yum gyi 'khor lo yang dpe'u chung bzhin bris te thod pa gnyis kyi rgya srub la yang rab tu dgra bo'i ming rus dang sngags tshang bar bri/ thod pa gnyis la yab yum gnyis kyi 'khor lo bag chus sbyar la/ bar dgra bo'i liṅgas bar mtshams med par bkang la/ thod pa gnyis kha sbyar la/ srad bu nag pos rgya gram du bsdams la dur khrod kyi me la bsro zhing bsnyen pa zhag gsum bya/ de nas thod pa maṇ+ḍal gyi steng du bzhag la mi'i rgyus pas gzungs thag btags nas/ 'khor lo steng 'og gi sngags dang*/ gtso bo dang yum gyi sngags 'bum phrag bzlas pa rdzogs pa na/ gshin rje'i 'khrul 'khor snying gar bcug nas/ dur khrod dam lha khang ngam lha klu drag po'i gnas su mnan no// de ltar byas pas lha la sogs pa yang 'chi bar 'gyur na 'gro ba gzhan lta ci smos/ pha ma bla ma mchod pa'i gnas// gang yin mchod pa nyid du bya// nges par 'grub gsungs/

bsnyen sgrub bsad gsum gyi man ngag rgya rgya rgya/ kha thaṃ/ kha thaṃ/ shin tu gsang ngo*// ༈ /'chi bdag las kyi gshin rje'i sgrub thabs rgya ston rin po ches mdzad pa bzhugs so// rdo rje 'jigs byed phyag 'tshal nas// las kyi gshin rje'i sgrub thabs bri// slob dpon chen po la li ta badz+ra gyis mdzad pa'i gshin rje chos kyi rgyal po'i sgrub thabs la gsum/ bsnyen pa/ sgrub pa/ las la sbyar ba'o// gnas dben par rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi bsnyen pa sngon du song bas/ ro ras la gri khrag dang dug dang ro sol gyis yab yum gyi thang ka khru gang gi tshad du bri/ rang nyid rdo rje 'jigs byed du bsgom/ mtsho ma dros pa'i 'og nas chos rgyal yab yum spyan drangs la bstim/ spyi bor rdo rje nag po res dbu brgyan par bsam/ thang kha kha byang du bstan/ rang re lhor blta/ mdun du dmar gtor re bsham/ thun gtor mgo rang nyid rdo rje 'jigs byed du bsgoms la/ hrīḥṣ+ṭīḥbargya rtsa re bzla/ oṃ kā la rū pa ya ma rā dza hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces brjod pas thang ka mi dmigs pa las hūm̐ mthing nag tu gyur/ de las 'od 'phros dgra bgegs tshar bcad/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las gshin rje chos kyi rgyal po ma he sngo nag rab tu khros pa'i steng na zhabs g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang gi stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ sku mdog char sprin ltar nag pa/ ma he'i zhal can spyan gsum dmar la zlum pa/ mche ba bzhi gtsigs pa/ ral pa kham ser gyen du brdzes pa/ gcer bu rus pa'i phreng bas mgul pa brgyan pa/ g.yas pas dbyug to 'phyar ba/ g.yon sdigs mdzub dang bcas pa'i zhags pa nag po 'dzin pa/ oṃ hrīḥṣ+ṭīḥtsa muṇ+ḍī hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces brjod pas de'i g.yon du hrīḥmathing nag las 'od 'phros pas/ dgra bgegs tshar bcad tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las tsa muṇ+ḍī mthing nag spyan gsum pa/ kha gdangs pa/ khro gnyer bsdus pa/ skra kham pa gyen du brdzes pa/

nu ma 'phyang ba/ gsus pa che ba/ yan lag thung zhing rags pa/ g.yas tri shū la g.yon thod khrag 'dzin pa/ stag gi pags pa gyon par bsam/ rang gi thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas mtsho ma dros pa'i 'og nas yab yum spyan drangs la bstim/ rdo rje'i phyag rgya bstan la sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ zhes pas dam la bzhag rang gi thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros yab kyi thugs ka'i hūm̐ dang yum gyi thugs ka'i hrīḥmathing nag la phog pas 'dar phri li li byed par bsam/ kā la rū pa bhi ma yak+ṣa hūm̐ a dhi pa ta ye/ ya ma rā dza hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ zhes pa'i bsnyen pa la 'bum tsho gcig bzlas/ oṃ kā la rū pa bhi ma yak+ṣa hūm̐ ma hā ro ṣa ṇa na ra sid+dha ye sarba bhū ta a dhi pa ta ye ya ma rā dzā ya hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ zhes pas bsnyen pa ste/ rtags ma byung bar du bzla/ oṃ hrīḥtsa muṇ+ḍī ye hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ zhes pa yum gyi bsnyen pa'o// rtags ni sku gzugs 'dar ba dang*/ me stag 'phro ba dang*/ thog 'tsheg pa dang*/ sa g.yo ba dang*/ mi nag dang*/ bud med nag mo'i tshogs rmi ba'o// gtor ma yang oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis dgra bgegs kyi sha khrag tu bsams la/ oṃ kā la rū pa ya ma rā dza hūm̐/ oṃ hrīḥtsa muṇ+ḍī ye i daṃ ba liṃ gṛh+ṇa kha kha khā hi khā hi/ zhes pas dbul/ gsur chen gyi dud pa btang*/ 'chi bdag nag po lho phyogs kyi// zhes sogs kyis bskul lo// gnyis pa sgrub pa ni/ grog mkhar gyi sa dang*/ rnam snang gi lder so zhig po'i sa dang*/ ro sol dang sa man bsres la bong bu'i chus sbrus te/ las gshin gyi gzugs khru gang pa khong stong bya/ mi rabs chad kyi thod pa/ bam ril gyi ya thod/ 'chi bdag bai bha swa ta'i gzugs rang yod/ bya rog gi khrag ro sol dang bong bu'i chus bsres la snag tsha bya/ mi rkang gi smyug gus bai bha sba ta'i gzugs gsal btab/ ro ras la gong gi snag tsha dang*/ smyug gus gtso bo'i nga rgyal gyis bltas te/

yab chos rgyal gyi lte bar 'khor lo rim pa gsum gyi lte bar dgra bo'i ming dang sarba sha trūṃ a mu ka zhes pa bri/ bar gyi re mig brgyad la shar du/ tro sa ya tro sa ya dgra bo mā ra ya phaṭa/ shar lhor a ka ḍa ḍha ya a ka ḍa ḍha ya dgra bo mā ra ya phaṭa/ de bzhin du lhor sho ṣa ya sho ṣa ya/ lho nub tu ha na ha na/ nub tu da ha da ha/ nub byang du pa tsa pa tsa/ byang du bhan+dha bhan+dha/ byang shar du tsur+ṇa tsur+ṇa/ mtha' ma'i re'u mig brgyad la/ shar du tsakra badz+ra na gho ra sa tra ya dgra bo mā ra ya phaṭa/ de bzhin du shar lhor k+ṣe tra pā la ya/ lhor tshin+dha tshin+dha/ lho nub tu bhin+dha bhin+dha/ nub tu thaṃ kha bha dze pa ti/ nub byang du ru dhi ra ar+gha pa/ byang du mā da sa ya/ byang shar du badz+ra ye badz+ra ye/ s+t+waṃ bha ya dgra bo mā ya ya phaṭ/ ces pa bri/ yum tsa muṇ+ḍī lto bar 'khor lo rim pa gsum bris pa'i lte bar sarba sha trūṃ/ pa ra pa ra a mu ka s+ya/ dgra bo mā ra ya phaṭa/ de bzhin du shar lhor dhu na dhu na/ lhor bhan+dha bhan+dha/ lho nub tu mā tha mā tha/ nub tu pra mā tha pra mā tha/ nub byang du hūm̐ dz+wa ra dz+wa ra/ byang du dz+wa re na bh+yo/ byang shar du dhi ro ge ni/ rim pa tha ma'i shar du nyi ka na shaṃ baṃ dgra bo mā ra ya phaṭa/ de bzhin du shar lhor yaṃ raṃ raṃ tshus ya/ lhor a bhi ṣa ya/ lho nub tu dzaṃ baṃ hri da yaṃ/ nub tu tshin+dha tshin+dha/ nub byang du ma ra ba shi bhaṃ/ byang du mā ra ya/ byang shar du nā sha ya dgra bo mā ra ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces pa ni/ 'khor lo de gnyis kyi bar du dgra'i ling ga ming rus thams cad bris nas gzhug bai bha swa ta'i gzugs kyi steng du mo 'khor 'og pho 'khor steng du bzhag mi'i rus pas 'khor lo gnyis rgya gram du bcing*/ de nas ya thod steng nas dgab/ rgya srubs la hrīḥṣ+ṭīḥbri/ skud pa sngon dmar gyis rgya gram du bcings la/ lder so'i nang du gzhug lder so'i brub khung zur gsum du byas la kha lhor bstan la bzhag

mdun du dmar gtor bsham/ rang nyid de'i rgyab tu kha lhor bltas la 'dug bdag nyid yi dam gyi nga rgyal gyis 'khrul 'khor gnyis po gshin rje gshed yab yum du bskyed/ de gnyis sbyor mtshams su dgra bo'i rnam shes bskyed la/ thun mgo la dgug gzhug bya/ nyin par gshin rje pho nya bas/ yab kyi bsnyen pa byas te/ tro sa ya gnyis/ a ka ḍa ḍha ya gnyis/ sho ṣa ya gnyis/ ha na gnyis/ da ha gnyis/ pa tsa gnyis/ bhin+dha gnyis/ tsur+ṇa gnyis/ dgra bo mā ra ya phaṭa/ ces nyin phyed tshun chad bzlas/ tsak+ṣa badz+ra na gho ra sa tra ya/ k+ṣe ṭa pā la ya/ tshin+dha gnyis/ bhin+dha gnyis/ thaṃ ka pa tsa pa ti/ ru ng+ti ra ar+ghaṃ pa/ māṃ sa ya/ badz+ra ye gnyis/ s+t+waṃ bha ya gnyis/ dgra bo mā ra ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces pa phyi dro bzla'o// gshin rje pho mo'i dmag tshogs kyis dgra bo bsad/ sha zos khrag 'thung bar bsams la/ thod pa la thun gyis brab/ mtshan mo gshin rje mo nye bas yum gyi bzlas pa bya ste/ srod la a mu ka s+ya/ dhu na gnyis/ bhin+dha gnyis/ mā tha gnyis/ pra ma thā gnyis/ hūm̐ dz+wa re gnyis/ dz+wa re na bh+yo/ dhi ro ge naṃ/ dgra bo mā ra ya phaṭa/ ces bzlas/ tho rangs nyi ga na shaṃ baṃ/ yaṃ raṃ raṃ tshus ya/ a bhi sha ya/ dza bhaṃ hri da yaṃ/ tshin+dha gnyis/ māng sa shi bhaṃ/ mā ra ya/ nā sha ya/ dgra bo mā ra ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces bzlas te thun gyis brab la/ gshin rje mo'i dmag tshogs rnams kyis dgra bo rnams bsang*/ sha zos khrag 'thung bar bsams la/ thun bar gong gi bzhin du gtor ma yang dbul/ de ltar zhag nyi shu rtsa gcig la sogs par bsgrubs pas mi nag po pho mos dgra bo bsad pa'i glo snying ster ba la sogs pa'i rtags 'byung ngo*// rtags ma byung na thod pa dang*/ lder so dur khrod kyi me la bdug cing*/ gong gi sngags rnams bzlas pas rtags 'byung ngo*// gsum pa las la sbyar ba ni/ mar ngo'i tshes brgyad dam bcu bzhi la dur khrod dam lha khang ngam lha klu drag po gnas pa'i sa ru dong gru gsum du/

'khor lo lder so dang bcas pa'i mgo lhor bstan la kha sbub tu mnan/ ro g.yam la rdo rje rgya gram dang ri rab bris pas mnan no// chos rgyal yab yum sgrub thabs 'di// bshes gnyen tshul khrims bla ma yis// bskul ba'i ngor byas rgya ston gyis// dben gnas gangs dkar rtsa bar bris// 'di shin tu zab pas dpe la bltas pas chog lag len rang shes yin pas gsang ba gal che// // ༈ /dam can chos kyi rgyal po lha bcu gsum gyi sgrub thabs rjes gnang gi cho ga dang bcas pa bzhugs so// na mo gu ru rat+na war+dhā ya/ chos sku zhi ba'i ngang nyid las// gzugs sku khro chen skur bzhengs nas// las nyon gshin rje 'joms mdzad pa'i// bla ma 'jigs byed la btud nas// de yi bka' sdod dregs pa'i gtso// dam can chos kyi rgyal po ni// 'khor dang bcas pa'i gtor chog dang*// rjes gnang cho ga bshad kyis nyon// rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi rnal 'byor pas dben pa'i gnas su/ yi dam chos skyong gi bris sku dang*/ sha khrag gis brgyan pa'i gtor ma du dgos pa dang*/ mchod pa ci 'byor pa bshams la/ bdag bskyed rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi mngon rtogs rgyas bsdus ci rigs pa sngon du 'gro bas/ mchod pa byin rlabs byas la/ gtor ma rnams nang mchod ltar byin gyis brlab/ yi dam chos skyong phyogs skyong rnams la so so'i cho gas phul/ las gshin gyi gtor ma byin rlabs dran par byas la/ nam mkha'i khams su rlung nag rdo rje bu yug gi 'tshub ma'i nang du bskal pa 'jig pa'i dus kyi nyi ma lta bu'i kha dog sna tshogs pa'i me dpung rab tu 'bar bas bskor ba'i dbus su/ rdo rje'i sa gzhi lcags zhun ma lta bu'i steng du/ rak+ta'i rgya mtsho chen po gdug pa'i srog chags du mas yongs su khyab pa/ de'i dbus su keng rus kyi ri rab bya dang gcan gzan gtum po'i tshogs kyis yongs su gang ba'i/ dur khrod kyis bskor ba'i nang du gshin rje'i grong khyer chen po/

thod pa lcags kyi gzhal yas khang zlum po sgo bzhi pa/ steng keng rus kyis phub pa/ g.yang gzhi'i bla bre dang*/ rgyu rlon gyi lda ldi dang*/ rus pa'i phreng bas brgyan pa/ phyi nang kun tu khrag dang zhag dang keng rus kyi dum bus khyab pa'i dbus su/ gnam lcags 'bar ba las grub pa'i 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad pa'i lte bar pad+ma dang*/ nyi ma dang*/ ma he'i steng du ya las thod dbyug yas mtshan pa las/ 'chi bdag las kyi gshin rje dam can chos kyi rgyal po sku mdog nag po ma he rab tu khros pa'i gdong pa can/ phyag g.yas pas thod dbyug g.yon pas zhags pa 'dzin pa dur khrod kyi rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ liṅga dmar po gyen du langs pa/ zhabs g.yon brkyang gi stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ de'i g.yon du hrīḥlas rtse gsum hrīḥs mtshan pa las/ 'chi bdag chen mo tsa muṇ+ḍī sku mdog nag mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ g.yas tri shū la dang g.yon thod pa khrag gis gang ba bsnams pa/ nu ma 'phyang zhing lto ba che ba ba lang gi ko ba rlon pa gyon zhing rus pa'i phreng bas brgyan pa/ 'khor lo'i phyogs kyi rtsibs bzhi la ya ba ti dang*/ phya bsang dang*/ rmigs pa dang*/ ral pa tshar dgu ste las kyi gshed po bzhi ka'ang sku mdog mthing nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ phyag g.yas rnams na rim pa bzhin du be con dang*/ 'khor lo dang*/ gsal shing dang*/ mdung thung rnams 'dzin zhing*/ g.yon pa rnams kyis mtshon cha sna tshogs 'phen zhing 'debs pa/ rgyal po dang*/ blon po dang*/ ded dpon dang*/ pho nya'i tshul 'dzin pa/ mtshams bzhir kā la ra tṛ dang*/ gsod byed nag mo dang*/ nag mo chen mo dang*/ nam gru chen mo ste srid pa'i ma mo bzhi po thams cad kyang sku mdog dmar nag 'jigs shing mi sdug pa'i cha byad can zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ g.yas pa rnams na las kyi me long dang*/ nad kyi rkyal pa dang*/ tshon gyi gru gu dang*/ bdud kyi khram shing rnams 'dzin cing*/

g.yon pa thams cad sho rde dkar nag 'gyed pa/ sgo bzhir sgrol ba'i gying chen po bzhi ni/ ya ma da dhi dang*/ kā la pā sha dang*/ ya ma daṇ+ḍī dang*/ ya ma daṃṣ+ṭī ste bzhi ka'ang sku mdog dkar po/ 'jigs shing rngam pa'i gzugs can phyag g.yas pa rnams kyis/ lcags kyu dang*/ zhags pa dang*/ dbyug tho dang*/ mche ba 'bar ba rnams 'dzin cing*/ g.yon pa rnams kyis thod khrag 'dzin pa'o// de thams cad kyi dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ snying gar hūm̐/ rang gi thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas lho phyogs rim pa bdun gyi sa 'og nas/ dam can chos kyi rgyal po lha bcu gsum 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ hūm̐ 'di nas lho yi phyogs rol na// dpag tshad brgyad khri'i pha rol na// thod pa lcags kyi grong khyer na// yi dwags kun gyi ded dpon po// ma mo kun gyi tshogs rje po// gson gshin kun gyi tham kha ba// gson po bskos la 'debs pa po// shi ba rnams kyi gshed bu che// dge ba can gyi stangs 'dzin pa// sdig pa can gyi chad pa mkhan// legs nyes chos bzhin spyod pa po// chos rgyal gshin rje zhes bya ba// mngon shes rdzu 'phrul mthu rlabs can// 'khor bcas 'dir ni gshegs su gsol// hrīḥṣ+ṭīḥ'i mthar ya ma rā dza sa pa ri wā ra ā kar+ṣa ya dzaḥzhes pas spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥzhes pas bstim/ de bzhin du dbang lha gshin rje'i gshed rigs lnga spyan drangs/ nyer spyod lngas mchod de gsol ba btab pas/ oṃ badz+ra u da ka a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐/ zhes gsung zhing dbang bskur sku gang dri ma dag chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las rdo rje nag po rtse lnga pa re res dbur brgyan par bsam/ g.yas pa'i sdigs mdzub bsgreng ba be con gyi phyag rgya bstan te/ hrīḥṣ+ṭīḥ'i mthar ya ma rā dza sa pa ri wā ra sa ma ya s+t+waṃ zhes pas dam la gzhag rdo rje bsdams pa'i srin mdzub gnyis gshibs te bsgrengs pa bstan nas/

gshin rje'i rgyal po 'khor bcas rnams// dam tshig dbang gis 'dir brtan bzhugs// mchod pa tshul bzhin bzhes nas kyang*// phrin las mdzad cing de srid du// las grub bar du bzhugs su gsol// oṃ ya ma rā dza sa ma ya hoḥ zhes brjod/ spro na mchod pa rnams tshigs bcad dang bcas pas dbul te/ g.yas pas be con gyi phyag rgya dang*/ g.yon pas mchod pa so so'i phyag rgya byas la/ dgra bgegs ma lus bsgral ba'i khrag gi mtsho// zhag gi me tog dba' rlabs phreng ba g.yo// gting mtha' mi mngon ar+gha'i mchod pa 'di// ya ma rā dza 'khor dang bcas la 'bul// hrīḥṣ+ṭīḥdang ya ma rā dza sa pa ri wā ra oṃ ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ya hūm̐/ zhes dang*/ me tog bla bre gdugs dang phreng bas brgyan// rin chen rang bzhin tog dang kha bad bcas// ka ba brgyad ldan khang bu brtsegs pa 'di// ya ma rā dza sogs rkang pa bzhi pa dang*/ sngags kyi thog mtha' 'dra bar sbyar te/ puṣ+pe/ bdug pa'i sprin phung bai ḍūr+ya yi mdog /rin chen brtsegs pa'i dbyibs 'dra dri zhim ldan// sna tshogs spos kyi khang bzang mdzes pa 'di// dhū pe/ nyin mor byed pa'i nor bu rgyas pa ltar// phyogs mtshams mun pa drung nas 'byin byed pa'i// snang gsal gzhal yas kun nas 'bar ba 'di// dī pe/ lus ngag nas kyi dri ma 'khrud byed cing*// reg na bde ba'i reg bya dang ldan zhing*// yid 'ong dri mchog gzi brjid ldan pa 'di// gan+dhe/ kha dog dbyibs legs dri zhim ro brgya ldan// phyogs rnams kun na zhal zas ci mchis pa// gcig tu bsdus pa'i bdud rtsi chen po 'di// nai wi d+ya/ bsil snyan la sogs rol mo du ma'i tshogs// sna tshogs yid 'ong nga ro ldan pa'i sgra// khams gsum kun tu gsal bar sgrog pa 'di// shab+da/ kha dog dri ro nus pa phun tshogs shing*// dkar ser dmar ljang sngo ba'i gzi 'bar ba// kham zas la brten skye dgu tshim byed 'di// ba l+yā di zhes sogs dang nam mkha' mdzod kyi phyag rgya bcas la/

oṃ kā la rū pa ya ma rā dza sa pa ri wā ra sarba bigh+nān sha trūṃ mā ra ya i daṃ ba liṃ kha kha khā hi khā hi hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces gsum mam lnga'am bdun la sogs pas gtor ma phul la/ hrīḥṣ+ṭīḥci mang gi mthar/ oṃ kā la rū pa hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ kā la rū pa ya ma rā dza hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ kā la rū pa bhi ma yak+ṣa hūm̐ a dhi pa ta ye ya ma rā dza hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ kā la rū pa bhi ma yak+ṣa hūm̐ mahā ro ṣa ṇa na ra sid+dha ye sarba bhū ta a bhi pa ta ye ya ma rā dza hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ hrīḥtsa muṇ+ḍī bam̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ zhes pa rnams gang la mos pa gtso bor bzla zhing gzhan rnams ci rigs pa bzlas la/ gong gi 'di nas lho yi zhes sogs nas mthu rlabs can zhes pa'i mthar/ 'khor bcas 'dir ni bdag la dgongs// bdag ni rnal 'byor sgrub pa po// 'jam dpal gzhon nu'i thugs kyi sras// gshin rje'i gshed kyi rnal 'byor pa// rdzogs pa'i byang chub sgrub pa'i phyir// bsam pa byang chub sems kyis brlan// rgyud ni ye shes rdo rje 'chang*// gzi byin sku gsung thugs kyis bskyed// don ni 'gro ba yongs kyi don// las ni sangs rgyas kun gyi las// bka' ni dkon mchog gsum gyi bka'// chos rgyal 'khor dang bcas pa rnams// mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la// zhes sogs nas yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub mdzod// ces brjod la/ gtor ma lho phyogs su gom bdun du phyir mig mi blta bar phyin la sa gtsang sar bskyal/ khrus byas nas nang du 'ongs la rjes chog bya/ drug cu pa sogs kyi tshe drag po'i skul byed na/ spyan 'dren gyi/ 'dir gshegs rnal 'byor bdag la dgongs// zhes pa'i rjes su/ rgyal po 'khor dang bcas pa la// drag po'i las 'di gtad par 'dod// bstan la gnod byed dgra bo 'di// gson na 'gro ba yongs la gnod// dkon mchog gsum la rnam par 'tshe// dmigs kyi rnal 'byor yongs la sdang*// 'di dag myur du bsgral ba'i phyir// rgyal po 'khor bcas spyan 'dren na// dam tshig dbang gis gshegs su gsol// zhes pa sngags dang bcas pas spyan drang ba sogs cho ga thams cad gong bzhin byas la/

bcom ldan gshin rje'i gshed po'i bka'// zhes sogs kyis bskul byas nas/ dmar gyi ar+ghaṃ sbreng ba sogs drug cu pa'i gtor chog ltar bya'o// ༈ /rjes gnang byed na sbyor ba'i skabs su maṇ+ḍal gong gi sgom don dang bstun pa'i dkyil 'khor bri/ lha gnas rnams su phyag mtshan sku mdog dang mthun pa'i tshom bu dgod/ mtha' skor du mchod pa bsham/ maṇ+ḍal gyi mtha' 'am ci rigs par rjes gnang gi yo byad sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las kyi rten rnams rab gnas can bkod pa ci mdzes su gzhag slob dpon gyis gong du smos pa rnams bzlas pa'i bar du rdzogs par byas nas/ rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi dbang thob cing dam tshig gtsang ba'i slob ma gral byas la maṇ+ḍal dbul/ rdo rje slob dpon dgongs su gsol// dpal ldan nag po chen po yi// sku gsung thugs yon phrin las kyi// dbang rnams bdag la stsal du gsol// zhes lan gsum dang*/ rgyud dag pa'i slad du/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi// zhes sogs lan gsum bya/ gzhi dgod pa'i slad du/ swa bhā wa'i sngags kyis slob ma rnams stong par bsam/ de'i ngang las gong ltar bskyed/ gnas gsum byin gyis brlab/ lha phyogs dang mdun bskyed las 'khor bcas sngags rgyas spyan drangs la bstim/ dril gsil mi mdzad/ dbang lha spyan drangs te dbang bskur/ rdo rje rtse lnga pa'i rgyas btab par bsam/ rjes gnang dngos la dam can gyi sku slob ma'i spyi bor bzhag ste/ gti mug khros pa ya ma rā dza ni// gti mug can gyi rgyud la khyab par 'jug /gti mug tshul gyis gti mug dgra bgegs sgrol// me long ye shes dam tshig khyod la sbyin// hrīḥṣ+ṭīḥ'i mthar kā la rū pa ya ma rā dza tsakra a bhi ṣiñca mi/ zhes pa sku'i dang*/ slob dpon yi dam du gsal ba'i thugs ka nas sngags phreng byung ste slob ma dam can du gsal ba'i thugs kar thim par bsams la/

hrīḥṣ+ṭīḥs mgo drangs pa'i sngags rnams kyi bzlas lung dang*/ bcom ldan bdag la sogs dang*/ bcom ldan 'di la sogs kyi mthar sngags mgrin par bzhag ste/ 'dod chags khros pa sogs tshigs bcad lhag ma dang sngags kyi thog mtha' 'don pa bsgyur la/ sor rtog ye shes dam tshig khyod la sbyin// pad+ma zhes pa gsung gi dang*/ thod dbyug snying gar bzhag ste/ zhe sdang khros pa sogs nas/ chos dbyings ye shes dam tshig khyod la sbyin// badz+ra zhes pa thugs kyi dang*/ dam can gyi sgrub skor lag pa g.yas su byin te/ ser sna khros pa sogs nas/ mnyam nyid ye shes dam tshig khyod la sbyin// rat+na zhes pa yon tan gyi dang*/ las gshin pho mo'i 'khor lo lag pa g.yon du byin te/ phrag dog khros pa sogs nas/ bya grub ye shes dam tshig khyod la sbyin// karma zhes pa phrin las kyi rjes su gnang ba sbyin pas/ slob mas chos kyi rgyal po'i sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las dang bcas pa'i rjes su gnang ba thob nas/ nyon mongs pa dug lnga 'khrul pa'i dbang gis bdud dang gshin rjer snang ba'i rnam par rtog pa thams cad dpyad na/ gshis lugs la cir yang ma grub pa'i/ stong pa 'od gsal chen por shes pa'i ngang nas snang ba snang stong*/ gsal ba gsal stong*/ rig pa rig stong gi ngang cung zad cig mnyam par bzhag gtor dbang byed na sngags brjod cing*/ las gshin gyi gtor ma mgo bor bzhag la bla ma brgyud pa'i mtshan nas brjod de bka' bsgo bya'o// gtso bos/ maṇ+ḍal/ deng nas sogs spyi dang mthun/ slob dpon gyis mdun bskyed la ci ltar rigs pas mchod/ yig brgyas lhag chad kha bskang*/ nongs pa bzod par gsol/ bris sku sogs yod na brtan bzhugs bya/ gzhan rnams la/ oṃ khyed kyis sems can don kun mdzod sogs kyi mthar gshegs su gsol/ maṇ+ḍal gyi rdul tshon mtha' nas bsdus te chur dor/ bsngo ba smon lam bkra shis bya'o// de ltar rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi// bka' sdod dam can 'khor bcas kyi// sgrub thabs rjes gnang cho gar bcas// don gnyer slob mas bskul ba'i ngor// sbyar ba'i dge bas 'gro ba kun// bdud dang gshin rje'i 'jigs pa las// rgyal nas bde chen rdo rje'i sku// skye 'chi med pa de thob shog

/'di'i rjes gnang gi brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'jigs byed/ ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma/ la li ta badz+ra/ a mo gha badz+ra/ ye shes 'byung gnas sbas pa/ pad+ma badz+ra/ dī paṃ ka ra shrī dz+nyā na/ rwa lo tsā ba rdo rje grags/ rwa chos rab/ rwa ye shes seng ge/ rwa 'bum seng*/ rong pa rga lo/ lo tsā ba mchog ldan/ bla ma dpal ldan seng ge/ bla ma seng ge rgyal mtshan/ zhang ston bsod nams grags/ gnyan ston rdo rje grags/ jo gdan nam mkha' lhun bzang*/ sngags 'chang rin chen rnam rgyal/ mus chen sangs rgyas rin chen/ 'jam dbyangs kun dga' bsod nams/ des bka' drin gyis bskyangs pa btsun pa dkon mchog lhun grub kyis rang gi bla ma las ji ltar thos pa ltar me lug snron gyi zla ba'i nyer dgu'i nyin dpal e waṃ chos ldan du bris pa'o// ༈ /brgyud pa'i kha skong ni/ thams cad mkhyen pa dkon mchog lhun grub nas/ mtshungs med dkon mchog dpal ldan/ paṇa chen nam mkha' dpal bzang*/ rje btsun nam mkha' sangs rgyas/ rje dam chos bsam 'grub/ mkhas grub sangs rgyas phun tshogs/ rigs brgya'i mgon po rdo rje 'chang bkra shis lhun 'grub la'o// ༈ /dam can chos rgyal 'khor bcas kyi rjes gnang mtshams sbyor mdor bsdus bzhugs so// na mas+saṅgu ru pa dā ya/ 'dir dam can chos kyi rgyal po 'khor bcas kyi rjes gnang sgrub pa la/ sngon 'gro slob dpon gyi bya ba rnams thams cad mkhyen pa dkon mchog lhun grub kyi yig cha bzhin grub rjes rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi dbang thob pa'i dam tshig dang ldan zhing nang gshin pa bcu gcig tshun ji ltar rigs pa khrus byas/ me tog bkye bsdu grub nas/ slob dpon gyis zang zing la mi blta ba'i snying rje dang*/ lha'i nga rgyal brtan po dang ldan pa'i sgo nas 'di skad ces brjod do// 'o nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad kyi don du sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya ba dang*/

gnas skabs su dam pa'i chos sgrub pa la 'gal rkyen bar chad thams cad zhi bar byed pa'am/ sel bar byed pa'i ched du dam can chos kyi rgyal po 'khor dang bcas pa'i rjes su gnang ba zab mo zhus la dam tshig dang sdom pa la bsrung sdom tshul bzhin du bgyi'o snyam pa byang chub kyi mchog tu sems bskyed pa gsal btab nas gsan 'tshal/ de la rang res chos sgrub pa la bdud rigs kyi bar chad nye bar 'tshe ba du ma 'byung bar gsungs te/ sher phyin sdud pa las/ rin chen chos kyang dkon la rtag tu 'tshe ba'ang mang*// zhes sogs mdo rgyud bstan bcos rnams las rgya cher gsungs so// de yang gang zag rab la ni bar chad kyis mi tshugs la/ las dang po pa dad brtson dang ldan pa lam nyams su len pa rnams la 'byung ste/ 'jam dpal rnam par 'phrul pa'i mdo las kyang*/ mi brtson pa la ni bdud kyis ci zhig bya ste/ de nyid bdud yin pa'i phyir ro// zhes sogs bar chad kyi rtags ni/ tshe 'di'i rnyed bkur sogs 'dod pa yin te/ de la brten nas thos bsam sgom pa la mi brtson pa dang*/ chags sdang rgyas shing chos la sems zhum pa dang*/ 'jig rten gyi bya ba cher 'bar ba sogs 'byung bar bshad do// bar chad kyi tshul ni/ lha'i bu'i bdud ces pa 'phral rnyed bkur sogs 'phel ba ltar byas nas chos la bar du gcod/ nyon mongs pa'i bdud 'dod chags zhe sdang sogs rang dbang med par skye/ phung po'i bdud na tsha sdug bsngal skyed/ 'chi bdag gi bdud srog rtsa la zhugs nas bar du gcod par byed do// bar chad de rnams zhi bar byed pa'i thabs la gnyis las/ dang po thabs kyi sgo nas zhi bar byed pa ni/ bdud las rnam rgyal las/ bar du gcod pa'i bdud rnams kyang*// gnyen po byang chub sems mchog gis// zhi ba chen po'i ngang du bzlog /ces pa'i tshul gyis chos brgyad dor nas dam tshig dang sdom pa la gnas pas/ phrag dog la sogs pa rnams spangs nas byang chub kyi sems gtso bor bsgom pa'am/

yang na srung ba'i 'khor lo sngags mdud sogs kyi sgo nas sel bar byed dgos pa yin no// gnyis pa shes rab kyi sgo nas zhi bar byed pa ni/ rang sems 'khrul pa'i dbang gis med pa la yod par 'dzin pa'i dgra 'drer snang ba la sogs pa rnams bar chad yin zhing*/ de nyid rang gi ngo bos stong zhing spros pa'i mtha' thams cad dang bral ba blos cir yang mi gzung bar de kho na nyid kyi ngang las ma bcos par bzhag pa ni don dam pa'i srung ba'o// 'dir snga ma ltar thabs kyi sgo nas srung bar byed pa la chos skyong khyad 'phags re bstan dgos/ de la 'jig rten pa'i srung ma dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i srung ma gnyis las/ dang po ni/ pho lha mo lha zhang lha sogs bsten kyang tshe 'dir 'gal rkyen bar chad phra mo tsam sel ba dang*/ mthun rkyen cung zad sgrub nus kyang*/ mthar thug byang chub ma thob kyi bar gyi 'gal rkyen bar chad zhi ba dang*/ mthun rkyen byang chub sgrub par mi nus pas bsten kyang don chung ba yin te/ rgyal sras sems dpa' chen pos/ rang nyid 'khor ba'i btson rar bcings gyur na// 'jig rten lha yis su zhig skyob par nus// zhes snying rje'i bsam pas gtor ma re tsam ster ba ma gtogs bsten cing srung skyob byed pa'i lha ma yin te/ skyabs 'gro'i bslab bya dang 'gal bar mdo las bshad/ gnyis pa 'jig rten las 'das pa'i srung ma la'ang*/ phar phyin gyi srung ma ni dpal mgon bdun cu rtsa lnga sogs te/ de rnams bsten don 'grub par bshad/ 'dir de las khyad par du 'phags pa'i rdo rje'i theg pa nas gsungs pa'i srung ma re bsten dgos/ de la rgyud sde bzhi'i srung ma mang du yod pa las/ 'dir rnal 'byor bla med kyi srung ma yin/ de la thabs shes gnyis med gsum las/ 'dir thabs rgyud yin/ de la pha rgyud sde gsum du grags pa las 'dir gshin rje'i gshed kyi skor yin/

de la dmar nag 'jigs gsum las/ 'dir rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi bka' srung thun mong ma yin pa dam can chos kyi rgyal po 'khor bcas kyi rjes gnang sgrub pa'i skabs su babs pa yin/ 'di la rgyud yongs su ma bsgyur ba'i dbang du byas nas/ 'jig rten gyi 'chi bdag gshin rje rang rgyud pa'i lo rgyus dang*/ rgyud yongs su bsgyur ba 'jig rten las 'das pa'i gshin rje'i gshed kyi lo rgyus gnyis las/ dang po ni/ la li ta badz+ras mdzad pa'i las gshin gyi sgrub thabs las/ shi ba yi dwags rgyal po ni// 'chi bdag bdud ces bya ba ste// 'gro rnams kun gyi las kyi bdud// lus dang grib ma'i tshul bzhin du// 'gro ba kun la snang ba ste// phung po nying mtshams sbyor ba yis// 'jigs pa de yi gzugs mthong nas// gshin rje de yi dri ngan 'byung*// des na rang gi srog gi bdag /ltag pa'i phyogs na gnas pa ste// gtsigs pa can la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes gsungs shing*/ 'chi ba yi dwags rgyal po ni// ma dros mtsho yi 'bri mig nas// ri nag dgu yi pha mtha' ste// spos ngad ri bo'i bar dag la// mchu dang zheng du cha mnyam mtsho// de 'og dpag tshad lnga brgya'i 'og /'chi ba yi dwags rgyal po'i gnas// 'gro ba'i ltag pa'i phyogs na gnas// zhes gsungs pas/ phyi'i gnas ni mtsho ma dros pa'i 'og dpag tshad lnga brgya'i sa na yod cing*/ nang du skye 'gro'i ltag khung du gnas pa/ lus dang grib ma'i tshul du gnas pa/ phung po nying mtshams sbyor ba'i tshe 'chi bdag tu 'gyur ba yin la/ gnyis pa rgyud yongs su bsgyur ba 'jig rten las 'das pa'i gshin rje'i gshed kyi lo rgyus ni/ sngon rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi rgyud gsungs pa'i tshe/ gdul bya thun mong ba'i 'jig rten gyi dregs pa can thams cad btul/ de nas lho phyogs kyi rgya mtsho las brgal te gshin rje grong khyer chen po sgo med lcags mkhar bcu drug gi steng du byon te/

'chi bdag las kyi gshin rje btul nas/ dpal gshin rje gshed nyid 'chi bdag gi gzugs su sprul pa'i ye shes pa kho na yin no// des na 'jig rten pa'i gshin rje rang rgyud pa dang 'khrul par mi bya'o// de ltar na 'chi bdag gi gnyen po yin pas chos skyong 'di shin tu zab pa yin no// de lta bu'i rjes su gnang ba sgrub pa la/ sngon 'gro slob dpon gyi bya ba rnams grub nas/ khyed rnams gyi ngo skal du gyur pa la/ thog mar slob dpon la bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'jigs byed dngos yin snyam pa'i rjes su gnang ba zab mo zhu ba'i yon du maṇ+ḍal 'bul bar zhu/ de ltar maṇ+ḍal phul nas snyim pa me tog dang bcas pas thal mo sbyar te gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ rdo rje slob dpon dgongs su gsol// dpal ldan nag po chen po yi// sku gsung thugs yon phrin las kyi// dbang rnams bdag la stsal du gsol// zhes pas gsol ba btab nas rgyud dag par bya ba'i slad du dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ khyed rang rnams kyi mdun gyi nam mkhar bla ma dang rdo rje 'jigs byed gnyis su med pa'i dkyil 'khor la gzhan yang dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma'i tshogs bsam gyis mi khyab pas bskor ba/ 'og gi cha la dam can chos kyi rgyal po lha bcu gsum gyi dkyil 'khor la gzhan yang chos skyong ba'i srung ma bgrang ba las 'das pa bsam gyis mi khyab pas bskor ba sprin phung chen po 'thibs pa ltar du bzhugs par mos pa bya/ de dag gi spyan sngar bdag gzhan sems can thams cad 'khod nas sdig pa bshags pa la sogs pa yan lag bdun pa bgyid snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ dkon mchog gsum la sogs zhes pas rgyud dag par byas nas/ dngos gzhi rjes gnang gi gzhi dgod pa'i slad du dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ slob dpon la bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'jigs byed dngos yin snyam pa'i gus 'dud byas te slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer tsha zhing rtsub la reg pa tsam gyis thams cad tshig par byed pa'i nus pa can gyi 'od zer pho nya lta bu 'phros pas khyed rang rnams kyi sku lus la phog pas tshe thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib dang*/

khyad par du bar du gcod par byed pa'i gdon bgegs log 'dren thams cad dang rnam smin gdos bcas sha khrag gi phung po khams dang skye mched gzung 'dzin tha mal du 'dzin pa thams cad bsregs shing sbyangs te lus 'od kyi gang bu re rer gyur pa'i mos pa byas te de nyid la dmigs te slob dpon gyis/ oṃ swa bhā wa sogs nas haṃ/ stong pa'i ngang las nam mkha'i khams su rlung nag rdo rje'i sogs nas/ gnam lcags 'bar ba las grub pa'i 'khor lo rtsibs bzhi pa'i lte bar pad+ma dang nyi ma dang ma he'i steng du khyed rang rnams kyi sems nyid ya las thod dbyug yas mtshan pa las nas/ dam can chos kyi rgyal po lha bcu gsum 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes pas spyan drang*/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ zhes pas khyed rang rnams la gnyis su med par thim/ slar yang thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas gshin rje'i gshed rigs lnga 'khor bcas oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes pas spyan drang*/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐/ zhes sogs lngas mchod/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis 'di la mngon par dbang bskur ba stsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ oṃ badz+ra u da ka a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐/ zhes gsungs shing bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ sku gang*/ dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las rdo rje nag po rtse lnga pas dbu brgyan par mos pa mdzod/ de ni rjes gnang gi gzhi 'god pa yin/ de la brten nas rjes gnang dngos bya ba la thog mar sku'i rjes su gnang ba'i slad du slob dpon gyis dam can chos kyi rgyal po'i sku khyed rang rnams kyi spyi bor bzhag pas/ sku'i byin rlabs ma lus pa rgyud la zhugs pa'i mos pa mdzod/ gti mug khros pa ya ma rā dza ni// gti mug can gyi rgyud la khyab par 'jug /gti mug tshul gyis gti mug dgra bgegs sgrol// me long ye shes dam tshig khyod la sbyin// hrīḥṣ+ṭīḥ'i mthar kā la rū pa ya ma rā dza tsakra a bhi ṣiñca mi/

zhes pa sku'i rjes gnang yin/ gsung gi rjes gnang gi slad du dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ slob dpon yi dam du gsal ba'i thugs ka nas sngags phreng byung ste khyed rang rnams dam can du gsal ba'i thugs kar thim par mos la sngags 'di rnams kyi rjes zlos lan gsum re mdzad par zhu/ hrīḥṣ+ṭīḥ'i mthar/ oṃ kā la rū pa hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ kā la rū pa ya ma rā dza hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ kā la rū pa bhi ma yak+ṣa hūm̐ a dhi pa ta ye ya ma rā dza hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ kā la rū pa bhi ma yak+ṣa hūm̐ mahā ro ṣa ṇa na ra sid+dha ye sarba bhū ta a dhi pa ta ye ya ma rā dza hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ hrīḥtsa muṇ+ḍī bam̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ so sor lan gsum re/ slob dpon la drin lan gyi tshul du me tog gtor la 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ bcom ldan bdag gis gzung lags kyis// bcom ldan bdag la 'go bar mdzod// lan gsum/ slob dpon gyis kyang khyed rang rnams kyis phul ba'i me tog gi phreng ba de nyid sngags su byas pa khyed rang rnams kyi spyi bor bzhag ste byin gyis brlabs pa'i mos pa mdzod/ bcom ldan 'di la stsal lags kyis// bcom ldan 'di la 'go bar mdzod// bcom ldan 'das kyi byin rlabs ni// 'di la 'go bar mdzad du gsol// sngags kyi dngos grub stsal du gsol// brtul zhugs brtan par mdzad du gsol// tshar gcig brjod pas me tog sngags su byas pa slob ma'i spyi bor bzhag slar yang sngags byung mgrin par bzhag ste/ de dag brtan par byas te gsung gi byin rlabs ma lus pa ngag la zhugs pa'i mos pa mdzod/ 'dod chags khros pa ya ma rā dza ni// 'dod chags can gyi rgyud la khyab par 'jug /'dod chags tshul gyis 'dod chags dgra bgegs sgrol// sor rtog ye shes dam tshig khyod la sbyin// hrīḥṣ+ṭīḥ'i mthar kā la rū pa ya ma rā dza pad+ma a bhi ṣiñca mi/ zhes pa gsung gi rjes gnang yin/

thugs kyi rjes gnang gi slad du/ slob dpon gyis thod dbyug snying gar bzhag pas thugs kyi byin rlabs ma lus pa rgyud la zhugs pa'i mos pa mdzod/ zhe sdang khros pa ya ma rā dza ni// zhe sdang can gyi rgyud la khyab par 'jug /zhe sdang tshul gyis zhe sdang dgra bgegs sgrol// chos dbyings ye shes dam tshig khyod la sbyin// hrīḥṣ+ṭīḥ'i mthar kā la rū pa ya ma rā dza badz+ra a bhi ṣiñca mi/ zhes pa thugs kyi rjes gnang ngo*// yon tan gyi rjes gnang gi slad du/ dam can gyi sgrub skor lag pa g.yas su byin te/ yon tan gyi byin rlabs ma lus pa rgyud la bzhugs pa'i mos pa mdzod/ ser sna khros pa ya ma rā dza ni// ser sna can gyi rgyud la khyab par 'jug /ser sna'i tshul gyis ser sna'i dgra bgegs sgrol// mnyam nyid ye shes dam tshig khyod la sbyin// hrīḥṣ+ṭīḥ'i mthar kā la rū pa ya ma rā dza rat+na a bhi ṣiñca mi/ zhes pa yon tan gyi rjes gnang ngo*// phrin las kyi rjes gnang gi slad du/ las gshin pho mo'i 'khor lo lag pa g.yon du byin te/ phrin las kyi byin rlabs ma lus pa rgyud la zhugs pa'i mos pa mdzod/ phrag dog khros pa ya ma rā dza ni// phrag dog can gyi rgyud la khyab par 'jug /phrag dog tshul gyis phrag dog dgra bgegs sgrol// bya grub ye shes dam tshig khyod la sbyin// hrīḥṣ+ṭīḥ'i mthar kā la rū pa ya ma rā dza karma a bhi ṣiñca mi/ zhes pa phrin las kyi rjes su gnang ba ste/ de ltar na khyed rang rnams chos kyi rgyal po'i sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las dang bcas pa'i rjes su gnang ba thob nas/ nyon mongs pa dug lngar 'khrul pa'i dbang gis bdud dang gshin rjer snang ba'i rnam par rtog pa thams cad la dpyad na/ gshis lugs la cir yang ma grub pa'i stong pa 'od gsal chen por shes pa'i ngang nas snang ba snang stong*/ gsal ba gsal stong*/ rig pa rig stong gi ngang cung zad cig mnyam par 'jog par zhu/

slob dpon gyis me tog gtor la/ bcom ldan 'di la sogs brjod pa'i mthar rdo rje slob ma 'di rnams kyi rgyud la las kyi gshin rje dam can chos kyi rgyal po lha bcu gsum gyi sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las dang bcas pa'i byin rlabs ma lus pa 'jug par gyur cig des rjes gnang gi dngos gzhi grub nas gtor ma'i dbang gi slad du dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ khyed rang rnams kyi spyi bo'i steng na yod pa'i gtor ma 'di nyid pad+ma dang nyi ma ma he dang bcas pa'i gdan gyi steng du las kyi gshin rje dam can chos kyi rgyal po lha bcu gsum la gzhan yang phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma'i tshogs bsam gyis mi khyab pas bskor ba/ de'i steng nas yar la rtsa ba'i bla ma nas brgyud pa'i bla ma'i bar tho brtsegs su bzhugs pa la/ rtsa ba'i bla mas bka' bsgo ba bzhin du brgyud pa'i bla ma yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad mgrin gcig tu bka' bsgos pa'i mos pa mdzod/ oṃ hrīḥṣ+ṭīḥsogs dang*/ dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed/ ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma/ la li ta badz+ra/ a mo gha badz+ra/ ye shes 'byung gnas sbas pa/ pad+ma badz+ra/ dī paṃ ka ra shrī dz+nyā na/ rwa lo tsā ba rdo rje grags/ rwa chos rab/ rwa ye shes seng ge/ rwa 'bum seng*/ rong pa rgwa lo/ lo tsā ba mchog ldan/ bla ma dpal ldan seng ge/ bla ma seng ge rgyal mtshan/ zhang ston bsod nams grags/ gnyen ston rdo rje grags/ jo gdan nam mkha' lhun bzang*/ sngags 'chang rin chen rnam rgyal/ mus chen sangs rgyas rin chen/ 'jam dbyangs kun dga' bsod nams/ thams cad mkhyen pa dkon mchog lhun grub/ mtshungs med dkon mchog dpal ldan/ byams pa kun dga' bkra shis/ shar chen shes rab 'byung gnas/ mtshungs med dam chos bsam 'grub/ mkhas grub sangs rgyas phun tshogs/

rdo rje 'chang bstan 'dzin lhun grub/ byams pa dpal ldan chos skyong*/ sku dbon rin chen mchog grub/ byams pa nam mkha' 'chi med/ mkhan chen rdo rje 'chang byams pa kun dga' bstan 'dzin/ rdo rje 'chang rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug 'jam dpal bzang po la sogs pa drin chen rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams dang*/ bcom ldan 'das dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi bka' dang dam las ma 'da' bar/ dam can chos kyi rgyal po lha bcu gsum 'khor dang bcas pa khyed rnams kyis sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa srungs/ dkon mchog gi dbu 'phang bstod/ dge 'dun gyi sde skyongs/ khyad par du yang rdo rje slob ma 'di rnams kyi lus dang grib ma bzhin du 'grogs nas 'gal rkyen sol/ mthun rkyen sgrubs/ zhi rgyas dbang drag gi las thams cad dang*/ khyad par du yang drag po mngon spyod kyi las thams cad thogs med du sgrubs shig ces bsgos pas las gshin 'khor bcas kyis kyang de ltar bgyi'o zhes zhal gyis bzhes/ 'khor rnams gtso bo la thim/ gtso bo yang khyed rnams la thim par mos pa mdzod/ rjes gtso bos sogs dang gtang rag gi maṇ+ḍal/ deng nas sogs spyi dang mthun par bya/ slob ma rang gnas su btang ngo*// zhes dam can chos kyi rgyal po lha bcu gsum gyi rjes gnang gi lhan thabs 'di'ang rgyal khams kyi mu to ba ngag dbang legs grub kyis dpal e waṃ chos ldan du bris pa'o/// /sarba maṅga laṃ// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten rin po che bya rung kha shor gyi nye 'gram rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa glog klad dpar khang las/ bder gshegs 7skyabs rje bco brgyad khri chen rdo rje 'chang mchog gi thugs dgongs rdzogs ched/ skyabs 'og pa tshar grwa gu rus glog klad phyag deb ched 'grem spel zhus pa'i dge 'bras sangs rgyas zhing du bsngo'o// //
